provider: CUHK Department of Economics 2024-25 Major Programme Requirement and Course List
academicYear: Applicable to students admitted in 2024-25; current department curriculum link reviewed on 2026-07-28
note: The official Department curriculum page currently links the 2024-25 Economics Major Programme Requirement. Its regular Major path requires a minimum of 72 units: a 9-unit Faculty Package containing ECON2011 and two courses from different Social Science programmes, 27 units from eleven named Major Required courses, and 36 units of ECON electives at 3000 level or above. This supplement exposes the twelve department-listed core courses, including ECON2011, plus all 49 ECON courses at 3000 or 4000 level in the same official Course List. ECON1010, ECON1210, ECON1220, ECON1310 and ECON1420 appear in the general Course List but are neither fixed courses nor eligible for the 3000-or-above Major elective requirement, so they are excluded. The PDF also permits instructor-approved ECON courses at 5000 or above and defines five optional Concentrations, including open MATH and cross-department Data Analytics pools; it contains HKDSE and international mathematics exemptions, separate Associate Degree and Higher Diploma senior-entry paths, and a distinct CUHK-Tsinghua dual-degree route. Those open pools and alternative paths are not closed by the local rule engine. The resulting 61-course list is intentionally browse-only and must not produce a graduation completion percentage.
